Application Data.NAME: Elegant Stitch Tailoring
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Fashion Ave, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001-5678
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Elegant Stitch Tailoring specializes in providing custom-made clothing, alterations, and repair services for men's and women's apparel. We focus on high-quality fabrics and craftsmanship, catering to both individual clients and small businesses. Our services include bespoke tailoring, dress alterations, and garment repairs, ensuring a perfect fit and finish for every customer. We also offer consultations for special occasions, including weddings and events.
